name: ingestion_date
description: Calendar date (UTC) of the load run that produced this row.

name: service_code
description: AWS offer code, e.g. AmazonEC2 / AmazonRDS / AmazonS3.

name: service_name
description: Human-readable service name from products[].attributes.servicename when available.

name: region_code
description: AWS region code, e.g. us-east-1. 'aws-global' for global/non-regional offers.

name: version
description: AWS-supplied offer file version timestamp, e.g. 20260116160258.

name: publication_date
description: AWS publicationDate of the offer file.

name: offer_type
description: service | savings_plan -- which AWS catalog this row originates from.

name: rate_code
description: {sku}.{termCode}.{rateCode} composite from AWS priceDimensions.

name: offer_term_code
description: e.g. JRTCKXETXF for OnDemand, or RI offering term code.

name: term_type
description: OnDemand | Reserved | SavingsPlan.

name: price_per_unit
description: Effective USD price per unit (or the only currency if non-USD). BIGNUMERIC because AWS publishes 10+ fractional digits like 1.0E-4.

name: currency
description: Currency code matching price_per_unit, normally USD.

name: unit
description: Billing unit (Hrs, GB-Mo, Requests, ...).

name: starting_range
description: Tier start. AWS sometimes uses very large values, hence BIGNUMERIC.

name: ending_range
description: Tier end.

name: effective_date
description: Term effectiveDate when present.

name: description
description: priceDimensions[].description.

name: product_family
description: products[sku].productFamily.

name: attributes
description: Full products[sku].attributes bag -- service-specific. Query with JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.instanceType') etc.

name: term_attributes
description: Term-level attributes (LeaseContractLength, PurchaseOption, OfferingClass, ...).

name: price_per_unit_raw
description: Full pricePerUnit currency map preserved as JSON in case of multi-currency rows.

name: source_url
description: URL of the AWS offer file this row came from.

name: ingested_at
description: Exact UTC moment of load.
